jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - (Privacy & Security Controls)
jobs.description:
Would you like to build the safeguards that let researchers work with sensitive health records responsibly? 

Here you’ll design statistical and technical controls that keep volunteers’ data private while giving research teams quicker, safer access to what they need.
jobs.requirementsSection:
You don't need to tick every box below; if most of it sounds like you, we'd be glad to hear from you:

  • Solid experience using data science, machine learning, statistical modelling or analytics on large, messy real-world data.
jobs.benefitsSection:
• Competitive base salary from £80,000 
  • Pension – employer contributions of up to 12% 
  • 30 Days Holiday pro rata + Bank Holidays – taken when it suits you 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave – time for the moments that matter

jobs.title: Hybrid Data Analyst (Data Science Support)
jobs.requirementsSection:
• A sharp analytical mind and hands-on experience pulling and shaping data (SQL essential).
  • At ease building reports and trackers in Excel.
  • Some Python, or the appetite to learn it fast.
  • Happy to switch between routine reporting and open-ended modelling questions.
jobs.benefitsSection: Our well-being offer covers private medical cover, generous parental leave, a work-from-abroad policy, mental health support and regular team socials. A pension and other benefit schemes are included, your birthday is a day off, and you get 25 days of holiday a year.
